title: Identical-Particle Symmetry-Enabled Complete Coherent Control of Ultracold Atomic and Molecular Collisions
summary: We show that exchange symmetry in collisions of identical particles enables symmetry-protected coherent control of the total scattering cross section. For identical fermions, antisymmetrization enforces a common control phase among contributing channels within a given parity sector, yielding maximal control visibility. For identical bosons, phase-locking persists but with reduced visibility due to additional exchange (satellite) contributions.
